svg.title: When Argo CD takes over from Ansible
svg.desc: Part 1, Ansible and OpenTofu: vms, cluster, storage, gitops. Part 2, Argo CD: the root Application, one child Application per app, auto-sync. Part 3, Ansible: gateway, certs, identity, ui, checks. Below, an app moves from an Ansible role to Argo CD in five steps.
svg.text: When Argo CD takes over from Ansible
A c1 build runs in three parts: Ansible builds what Argo CD stands on, Argo CD installs every app, Ansible finishes from outside.
1. ANSIBLE AND OPENTOFU BUILD THE BASE
2. ARGO CD INSTALLS AND KEEPS EVERY APP
HOW ONE APP MOVES FROM ANSIBLE TO ARGO CD
